mutants.name: a failed denylist search counts as zero
mutants.old:
n1=$(grep -aEic -f <(deny_patterns) -- "$f" 2>/dev/null) || { rc=$?; (( rc == 1 )) || return 1; }
  n2=$(LC_ALL=C grep -aEic -f <(deny_patterns) -- "$f" 2>/dev/null) || { rc=$?; (( rc == 1 )) || return 1; }
mutants.new:
n1=$(grep -aEic -f <(deny_patterns) -- "$f" 2>/dev/null) || { rc=$?; true || return 1; }
  n2=$(LC_ALL=C grep -aEic -f <(deny_patterns) -- "$f" 2>/dev/null) || { rc=$?; true || return 1; }
